title: Pollinating birds differ in spectral sensitivity
why: Anthreptes, lambda_max_nm and spectral_range_nm: an SWS1 opsin survey of nectar-feeding birds that covers sunbirds (Nectariniidae), so it may give the SWS1 type (violet- or ultraviolet-sensitive) of an Anthreptes species, which bears on the pigment and spectral-range cells (an opsin sequence predicts a pigment class and does not measure a peak). Its species list is unseen. The AGRIS record came back for the web search "brown-throated sunbird spectral sensitivity"; not opened. Main's wanted lines sweep-18 and sweep-25 hold the same paper for Cinnyris, Anthochaera and Phylidonyris with its journal reference and DOI, and main's sunbird rows from two other SWS1 surveys (Ödeen et al. 2011; Ödeen and Håstad 2013) hold no Anthreptes.
get: journal via library (main's sweep-18 and sweep-25 lines say the same)
